language: Spanish narration (castellano rioplatense, voseo), English topic notes
note: Facts marked verify must be checked with a web search on the day of production. Never make health claims.

topics.title: How to prepare mate like an Argentine (step by step)
topics.angle: yerba 2/3 full, cover and shake, tilt into a slope, warm water on the low side, bombilla in, never stir

topics.title: Why you should never use boiling water
topics.angle: about 70 to 80 degrees C; boiling water burns the yerba and makes it bitter; the termo pico

topics.title: The cebador: the one person who serves
topics.angle: one person fills and passes, always back to the cebador, order goes around the circle

topics.title: Saying 'gracias' means you are done
topics.angle: thanking ends your turn in the ronda; tourists say it too early

topics.title: Never move the bombilla
topics.angle: stirring clogs the filter and is a small insult to the cebador

topics.title: Curing a new gourd (curar el mate)
topics.angle: new calabaza needs curing with used yerba for a day or two; wood too; steel and glass do not

topics.title: Calabaza, wood, steel, imperial: which gourd is which
topics.angle: materials and what they change in taste and care

topics.title: The bombilla is a filter, not a straw

topics.title: Why Argentines carry a thermos everywhere
